profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at SEI Investments Company
profile.summary: Hands-on Database developer. Database expert in Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, database design, and performance tuning. Oracle DBA. Proficient in Java, C#, .Net, Unix scripting, C, Python. Back-end application development, web applications, web services for Financial and Banking Trust Accounting applications, FIS Global*Plus, SEI Wealth Platform. Data analysis. Data transformations. Experienced in OLTP and Data Warehouse applications. Experience in systems integration, database encryption, and major technology transformations.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer / Tech Lead
positions.description: Sr. Developer for Data Migrations for a large financial services firm. Analyze client data requirements for integration into SEI’s Wealth Platform application. Programming, business analysis, testing, performance tuning, support. Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Korn Shell, SQL Developer, Toad, ControlM, Git.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer / Designer
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
positions.description: Designed, developed, and supported payroll tax software. Rewrite of legacy C application to Java. Upgraded database interface for tax calculation engine. Maintained and enhanced payroll application based on client requests. Problem analysis and resolution. Designed and implemented internal applications for use by tax research analysts. Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, C, Java, ODBC, .Net, NetBeans, Git, Python, Linux, SQLite, XML, XSL, IntelliJ IDEA, SonarQube.

positions.title: Sr. Database Designer / Architect / Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a large financial banking web application. Integrated front end application that communicates with FIS Global*Plus Trust Accounting System and Data Warehouse databases. Implemented client requested features. Designed and wrote data access layers. Tuned SQL to support complex, application-defined, rules-based data entitlements in a multi-tenant database. SQL optimization for inquiries and large data responses, across many production environments. Oracle instance tuning, data consistency, data replication. Wrote tools to support automated database installs and monthly upgrades. AIX, Oracle, performance, PL/SQL, Materialized Views, SQL Loader, C, Pro*C, AWR, shell, cron, C#, .Net.

Lead designer and developer for implementing database encryption - using Oracle tablespace-level encryption. Wrote an automated database encryption utility, including full verification, supporting large, 10 TB Oracle databases. SQL, Data Pump, Korn shell.

In addition, general responsibilities for: design reviews of all trust application and database changes across the division, Oracle support, application support, performance, training, mentoring, code reviews.

positions.title: Sr. Database Designer / Application Designer / Developer / Sr. DBA
positions.description:
.Net Web Application / Web Services
Application interfaced real-time with a legacy Trust Accounting System. Designed all tables for the project, integrating with several other sub-systems (multiple Oracle instance, 10 schema integration). Integration with real-time OLTP data. Wrote public web services. 

Data Warehouse / Web Application
Conversion of previous application from MS SQL Server to Oracle. Nightly extracts are loaded into Oracle data warehouse. Automated loads, scripting. Provide efficient data access to support inquiries and data consistency.

Java / Web Application / Web Services
Java/IBM Websphere web application. New front-end for banking application accessing large OLTP database. JAVA/J2EE development on IBM's WebSphere Application Server. Wrote web services and data access services.

Real-time Messaging Interface/XML/MQ
Real-time transaction posting into legacy trust accounting application - using IBM MQ, XML, Oracle and Pro*C. Designed, implemented all required tables. Apply updates and financial transactions received from customers, in XML format. High-volume, fault-tolerant design and tight integration with core application. Wrote Pro*C code generator. Highly tuned for multi-threaded access and performance. 

Oracle Database Administration / Data Modeling
Lead technical resource for all Oracle database activity within the division. Data Modeling for Trust Application, with several releases per year. Automated application database upgrades. Designed and implemented all Oracle backup/recovery procedures for development and production environments.  Full production support, including performance, disaster recovery and legacy database conversions. 

VAX-to-UNIX/Oracle Conversion
Lead designer and developer on a major, technology transformation project to convert large financial application (with 4+ million lines of code) from a proprietary, non-SQL database running on VAX/VMS to target architecture, running on Unix and Oracle.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer / Director of Development
positions.description:
Manager/Director of Development (1995 - 1997)
Managed core application development group. Staff of 30+ developers. Responsibilities: budget, project delivery, release content/schedule.

Sr. Software Developer (1991 - 1995)
Worked on major application technology project, re-hosting large OLTP financial application from Prime/Primos platform to VAX/VMS. Requirements, coding, testing. C, Fortran, PLI, DCL.

positions.title: Sr Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Application design, development for a Telecommunications and Computer Network Management and Billing System. VAX/VMS, RDB, Basic, DCL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Systems Administrator. VAX/VMS. Application Development and Support. VAX/VMS/RDB. Pascal, Basic. FORTRAN.
